QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Seeking Lost Memories
QuestInfo.0: According to the Memory Keeper, you must go back to the place where you first began your adventures in order to retrieve your lost memory. The place where you first began your adventures... That must be #b#m310000000##k, where you chose the path of the Resistance. Go to the Underground Base of the Resistance.
QuestInfo.1: You see #p2151003# for the first time in a while. She's ecstatic to see that you have become a true member of the Resistance. You feel warm and tingly inside, seeing that #p2151003# still remembers your first encounter...
